         3                  SENATOR MONTGOMERY:    To explain

         4       my vote, Mr. President.

         5                  ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:    Senator

         6       Montgomery, to explain her vote.

         7                  SENATOR MONTGOMERY:    Yes,

         8       Mr. President.  I have traditionally -- or at

         9       least I have, in the past, voted no on this

        10       legislation.

        11                  And the question and concern that I

        12       have is that we are passing a bill which would

        13       create a criminal penalty for possession of a

        14       so-called disguised knife, but we don't

        15       include in this legislation the sale of these

        16       items.

        17                  Now, interestingly enough, the

        18       sponsor indicates that these items are sold to

        19       youth and adults.  So if that is the case and

        20       we are concerned about it, why don't we punish

        21       the people who sell them along with the people

        22       who buy them?

        23                  So I think that this just does not

        24       go far enough.  And if we want to remove these

        25       items from possession by young people and/or


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         2       sell them.
